title: Joe Johnston
description: Joe Johnston's early version of a wampa ice creature (front) for THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK became shaggier and whiter, but no less ferocious. Hired at Industrial Light & Magic two weeks out of college, Johnston did sketches and storyboards. For EMPIRE, he developed Yoda and the Imperial walkers. Nilo Rodis-Jamero drew this bug-eyed alien (back) for RETURN OF THE JEDI.
